title: I kept blowing trading accounts because I couldn’t stop myself from trading
summary: I’ve blown more trading accounts than I want to admit.Every time I told myself “just one more trade” and every time it ended the same way, blowing account after account which sucked so much. What finally clicked for me was realizing I don’t lose money because I don’t know setups, I lose money because I trade when I shouldn’tI ended up building a simple web app that forces me to explain why I’m taking a trade before I can take it. If my reasoning is emotional, it locks me outIt’s been helping me stay out of bad trades. Sharing in case it helps someone else:https://impulseaiapp.comsubmitted by/u/SethBright[link][comments]
